caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank labeled "ORGAN BANK" at the front, rendered in shades of brown, gold, and black, with ornamental detailing on its surfaces. The bank is box-shaped with four curved legs and a raised rectangular body, featuring a visible hand crank on its left side. On top of the bank are two small figurines: to the left, a human figure with light skin, yellow shirt, blue pants, red shoes, and hands raised to its head; in the center, a monkey dressed in a red jacket and yellow pants, sitting and holding a large circular object in its right hand. Both figures are positioned on circular platforms. The composition centers these objects on a plain tan background, with no other details or objects present.
title: Toy Bank: Monkey and Hurdy-Gurdy
